title: Instructions for Building an Altar
description: After the Lord has spoken from heaven, he gives Moses instructions on how the Israelites are to worship him. They must not make gods of silver or gold beside him. The altar is to be built of earth or of uncut stones—hewn stones would desecrate it. At every place where the name of the Lord is remembered, he promises to come and bless the people. They must also not go up to the altar by steps, so that their nakedness may not be exposed.
